# DiscoPoP B14 — two loops side by side inside a loop: the fix, its regression check, and what it changes on the programs the agent shipped

*Generated by `agent/tools/campaign.py reports` from `results/campaign.json` and the experiment record (`agent/THESIS_EXPERIMENTS.md`). Edit those, then regenerate — not this file.*

**Status:** done

## The question

After the profiler models the loops of a nest as a tree: does DiscoPoP alone still give every one of the 44 tsvc_c2 originals its measured class, and on how many of the agent's archived programs does DiscoPoP now report more loops as Do-All than it did?

## Result in one paragraph

Fixed in the profiler (7 Oct): the loops of a nest are modelled as a tree. DiscoPoP alone on the 44 tsvc_c2 originals is unchanged in two draws (no original has loops side by side). On the agent's 257 changed programs of E1-v6 and E2-v6, directives removed and profiled before and after: 86 gain loops and then have every loop reported — all 35 successes on the four constructed hidden-order kernels with evidence at one attempt, 37 and 10 in the three-attempt arms, 4 of 85 in E1-v6 (all s281). The defect had a second face: in 4 programs on k53 it reported the kernel's recurrence as Do-All; the gate's race stage had refused that directive in every one of those trials. No experiment has been run again.
